failure_mode_definitions.MATERIAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH: Source and candidate describe different concrete functions, software, equipment, lot, beneficiary, or procurement purpose.
failure_mode_definitions.ADMINISTRATIVE_VERSION_OR_RECTIFICATIF: The candidate is a rectificatif, notice version/update, cancellation/correction, or same procedure update rather than a distinct successor contract.
failure_mode_definitions.SAME_BUYER_BROAD_DIGITAL_SIGNAL: The apparent match is mainly driven by same buyer plus generic digital/procurement language.
failure_mode_definitions.HIGH_BUYER_ACTIVITY_AMBIGUITY: The buyer has many in-scope notices or the source has many candidates, creating many plausible same-buyer distractors.
failure_mode_definitions.NAME_FALLBACK_IDENTITY_RISK: The pair is blocked by buyer-name fallback rather than a stronger SIRET/SIREN identity.
failure_mode_definitions.HIGH_CPV_FALSE_SECURITY: The CPV score is high even though the manual label says the procurement objects differ.
failure_mode_definitions.LOW_TEXT_EVIDENCE: TF-IDF text similarity is low, so the accepted link lacks strong text evidence.
failure_mode_definitions.SMALL_MARGIN_AMBIGUITY: The top candidate is close to the runner-up; acceptance depends on an ambiguous ranking.
failure_mode_definitions.METHOD_DISAGREEMENT_FALSE_POSITIVE: Only one maintained method linked the source, and the reviewed proposed link was wrong.

scientific_caveat: Stratified/purposive audit; outputs are diagnostic and repair-oriented, not final population precision/recall estimates.
